faqs.question: How does ClinicPro protect patient records?
faqs.answer: ClinicPro is designed around role-based access, protected sessions, audit logs, and secure clinic workflows so sensitive information is visible only to the appropriate team members.

faqs.question: Can I control what each staff member can see?
faqs.answer: Yes. Configure access by role so front-desk staff, practitioners, billing teams, and clinic administrators see the tools and records relevant to their work.

faqs.question: Can I review changes made in the platform?
faqs.answer: Yes. The audit trail gives administrators a clear view of important actions, including access changes, record activity, and configuration updates.

faqs.question: What happens when a staff member leaves the clinic?
faqs.answer: An administrator can immediately remove the member's access and end their active sessions, keeping your workspace protected.
